about.title: Meet Dr. Hasti Hosseini
about.p1: Dr. Hasti Hosseini is among Tehran's most experienced physicians in the treatment of women's infections, and her precision has earned an exceptional level of satisfaction among the patients who visit the clinic — which is why so many people come to her for a second opinion.
about.p2: Her work spans vaginal laser therapy, laser treatment for infection, recurrent infection management, cervical laser therapy, genital wart treatment and Pap smears, and she is widely recommended by the patients she has treated.
points: Official member of the national medical council
